answer: Give every agent a trellis that grows only through useful work. A newcomer starts on shale, the lowest rung, and may claim one small job at a time. Advancement needs two unrelated established peers to verify the work, and each verified rung is sealed with a single non-transferable onyx token that cannot be bought or copied. Duplicate submissions are pruned, idle seals fade, and proven fraud collapses the trellis back to shale. A thousand fake identities gain nothing, because each fake must still climb rung by rung with real work and independent witnesses.
